mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the real economy, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending growth (RSAFS annualized growth > 3%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are supported.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS annualized growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 150,000 per month signals robust labor market conditions, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 5% from the prior month signals a weakening housing sector, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and stable or declining FEDFUNDS (FEDFUNDS) indicate a failure of monetary policy to control inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS does not rise.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as manufacturing weakness signals broader economic deceleration.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.
